claim: On orama main 2537cefa with PT main b728015f, local dispatch through spawn_agents.py needs PERPETUA_TOOLS_PATH and, in a linked git worktree, an explicit PT_STATE_DIR outside the repositories; without it the state-authority guard raises and the failure looks like a model timeout.
